verdict.rationale: Groq publishes an API reference, but the evidence describes it as a static per-endpoint reference rendered from an embedded OpenAPI document. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive explorer, try-it console, or runnable examples. The static reference and code snippets in the guides are adjacent documentation, not the interactive, runnable capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
